newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stock market closed for New Year's holiday.
newsitem.headline: Thai stock market closed for New Year's holiday.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Thailand was closed on Wednesday for New Year's Day holiday.
The SET index finished the last trading day of the year on Monday at a near 43-month low, dropping 4.14 points to close at 831.57 on 4.7 billion baht turnover.
The key index tumbled 35.07 percent since the beginning of 1996.
The market will reopen on Thursday, January 2.
